func start_new() -> void:
	stage = 0
	elapsed = 0
	kills = 0
	defeated.clear()
	reached_yard = false
	reinforcement_pending = 0
	reinforcement_next = 0
	reinforcement_wait = 0.0
	expanded_encounter = true
	story.reset()
	linear.reset()
	player.restore({"position": [START.x, START.y, START.z], "yaw": -0.6, "health": 100.0, "magazines": [5, 10], "reserves": [35, 50], "weapon": 0})
	_reset_guards()
	codebook.visible = true
	codebook.collision_layer = 1
	world.set_power(true)
	_save_checkpoint()
	resume()
	notify("林道前方是侦察员姜岚。靠近后按 E 交谈。J 查看行动记录。", 7)

func resume() -> void:
	mode = "playing"
	player.model.visible = true
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CAPTURED

func interact() -> void:
	if mode != "playing":
		return
	if linear.interact():
		return
	var at_evac := stage == 2 and can_reach(EVAC, 3.0)
	if at_evac and story.ready_to_leave():
		story.ending()
		return
	var objective_ready: bool = story.met_scout and stage < 2 and can_reach([BOOK, POWER][mini(stage, 1)], 2.3)
	if not objective_ready and story.interact():
		return
	if at_evac:
		story.ending()
		return
	if not story.met_scout or not can_reach([BOOK, POWER, EVAC, EVAC][stage], 2.3):
		return
	match stage:
		0:
			stage = 1
			codebook.visible = false
			codebook.collision_layer = 0
			notify("名册上记着密营联络点。切断总闸，阻止电话中继继续传讯。", 6)
			_save_checkpoint()
		1:
			stage = 2
			world.set_power(false)
			reinforcement_pending = REINFORCEMENT_COUNT
			reinforcement_next = 0
			reinforcement_wait = REINFORCEMENT_FIRST_DELAY
			_save_checkpoint()
			notify("中继电源已切断。接上陆山，绕电报房北侧去渡口！", 6)

func continue_checkpoint() -> void:
	var data := _read_save()
	if data.is_empty():
		data = checkpoint
	if data.is_empty():
		start_new()
		return
	stage = int(data.stage)
	defeated = data.defeated.duplicate()
	kills = int(data.kills)
	elapsed = float(data.elapsed)
	reached_yard = data.yard
	var encounter: Dictionary = data.get("encounter", {})
	expanded_encounter = encounter.get("expanded", false)
	reinforcement_next = int(encounter.get("next", 2 if stage >= 2 else 0))
	reinforcement_wait = float(encounter.get("wait", REINFORCEMENT_WAVE_DELAY if stage >= 2 else 0.0))
	player.restore(data.player)
	story.restore(data.story)
	linear.restore(data.get("linear", {}))
	_reset_guards(encounter.get("active", {}))
	if not data.has("linear"):
		# Old positions may overlap the new partitions. Only displaced actors move.
		player.position = world.relocate_to_walkable(player.position)
		story.people.lu.position = world.relocate_to_walkable(story.people.lu.position)
		player.reset_physics_interpolation()
		story.people.lu.reset_physics_interpolation()
		for guard in guards:
			guard.position = world.relocate_to_walkable(guard.position)
			guard.patrol_target = world.relocate_to_walkable(guard.patrol_target)
			guard.reset_physics_interpolation()
	codebook.visible = stage == 0
	codebook.collision_layer = 1 if stage == 0 else 0
	world.set_power(stage < 2)
	resume()
	notify("检查点已恢复。", 2)

func initialize(owner_node: Node3D) -> void:
	main = owner_node
	_add_person("scout", "姜岚 · 抗联侦察员", "scout", SCOUT)
	_add_person("logger", "林守义 · 林工", "logger", LOGGER)
	_add_person("lu", "陆山 · 交通员", "wounded", WOUNDED)
	door = main.world.box("电报房木门", DOOR, Vector3(0.18, 3, 3.65), "wood")
	parcel = main.world.box("医药包", SUPPLY, Vector3(0.6, 0.24, 0.4), "sandbag", false)
	main.world.box("补给矮箱", SUPPLY - Vector3(0, 0.48, 0), Vector3(0.9, 0.72, 0.65), "wood")
	main.world.navigation.set_point_solid(main.world.cell_at(SUPPLY))
	main.world.box("未寄出的家书", LETTER, Vector3(0.5, 0.025, 0.36), "paper", false)
	main.world.box("案边木架", LETTER - Vector3(0, 0.63, 0), Vector3(2.1, 1.0, 0.5), "wood")
	reset()
	moments = StoryMoments.new()
	main.add_child(moments)
	moments.initialize(main)

func reset() -> void:
	met_scout = false
	supply_choice = "none"
	read_letter = false
	supply_taken = false
	recruited = false
	bandages = 1
	speaker_id = ""
	people.scout.reset(SCOUT)
	people.logger.reset(LOGGER)
	people.lu.reset(WOUNDED)
	_set_door(false)
	parcel.visible = true
	if is_instance_valid(moments):
		moments.reset()

func choose(index: int) -> void:
	if main.mode != "dialogue" or index < 0 or index >= choices.size():
		return
	var action: String = choices[index].action
	if action == "route":
		show_dialog("scout", "姜岚", "从林道的木墙缺口进入，解决检查口岗哨，按 E 开栅门。木料巷还有两名守卫，清掉后继续开门向北。电报房入口在右手边。拿名册、断电并接上陆山后，绕房子北侧去渡口；到船边掩护他解缆。\n林师傅守在北面的木棚。和他当面说清楚，他会给你补给。", [{"label": "记住了，开始行动", "action": "brief"}])
		return
	close_dialog()
	match action:
		"brief":
			met_scout = true
			main.notify("行动记录已更新。J 查看记录；前方木棚可以向林师傅求助。", 6)
		"medicine":
			if supply_choice == "none":
				supply_choice = "medicine"
				bandages += 1
				main.notify("林守义递给你一卷干净布。绷带 +1。", 4)
		"ammunition":
			if supply_choice == "none":
				supply_choice = "ammunition"
				main.player.reserves[0] += 10
				main.notify("获得步枪弹 ×10。医药包还在运材场。", 4)
		"rescue", "rescue_treat":
			recruited = true
			people.lu.following = true
			if action == "rescue_treat":
				_treat()
			main.notify("陆山开始跟随。靠近他按 E 可让他等候或继续跟随。", 5)
		"follow":
			people.lu.following = true
		"wait":
			people.lu.following = false
		"treat":
			_treat()
		"finish":
			if ready_to_leave():
				main.stage = 3
				main.mode = "won"
				Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE
	if action not in ["close", "finish"]:
		main._save_checkpoint()

func ready_to_leave() -> bool:
	return recruited and people.lu.position.distance_to(main.EVAC) < 5.5 and main.stage == 2 and main.linear.can_evacuate()

func gate_ready(id: String) -> bool:
	if not main.story.met_scout:
		return false
	match id:
		"checkpoint": return main.defeated.has("gate_guard")
		"yard": return "checkpoint" in opened and main.defeated.has("yard_guard") and main.defeated.has("timber_guard")
		"river": return "yard" in opened and main.stage == 2 and main.story.recruited
	return false

func can_guard_act(id: String) -> bool:
	if not enabled:
		return true
	match id:
		"gate_guard": return contact_started
		"yard_guard", "timber_guard": return "checkpoint" in opened
		"office_guard": return "yard" in opened
		"pier_guard": return "river" in opened
	return "river" in opened

func can_evacuate() -> bool:
	return not enabled or ("river" in opened and extraction_started and extraction_remaining <= 0)

func restore(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	reset()
	if data.is_empty():
		set_enabled(false)
		return
	enabled = data.enabled
	opened.assign(data.opened)
	contact_started = data.contact_started
	extraction_started = data.extraction_started
	extraction_remaining = float(data.extraction_remaining)
	_sync_gates()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var previous_yaw := rotation.y
	var talking: bool = main.mode == "dialogue" and main.story.speaker_id == person_id
	nameplate.visible = main.player.position.distance_to(position) < 9 and main.mode == "playing"
	if main.mode != "playing":
		if talking:
			var facing: Vector3 = main.player.position - position
			rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, atan2(-facing.x, -facing.z), minf(1.0, delta * 9))
		model.set_motion_context(treated, angle_difference(previous_yaw, rotation.y) / maxf(delta, 0.001))
		model.animate(delta, 0, talking)
		return
	var direction := Vector3.ZERO
	var distance: float = position.distance_to(main.player.position)
	if following and distance > 2.2:
		route_clock -= delta
		if route_clock <= 0:
			route = main.world.path(position, main.player.position)
			route_index = 1 if route.size() > 1 else 0
			route_clock = 0.5
		if route_index < route.size():
			var offset := route[route_index] - position
			offset.y = 0
			if offset.length() < 0.45:
				route_index += 1
			else:
				direction = offset.normalized()
	var speed := 3.2 if treated else 2.2
	velocity.x = direction.x * speed
	velocity.z = direction.z * speed
	velocity.y = -0.2 if is_on_floor() else velocity.y - 20 * delta
	move_and_slide()
	var facing := direction
	if distance < 4 and direction.length() < 0.1:
		facing = main.player.position - position
	if facing.length() > 0.1:
		rotation.y = lerp_angle(rotation.y, atan2(-facing.x, -facing.z), delta * 4)
	model.set_motion_context(treated, angle_difference(previous_yaw, rotation.y) / maxf(delta, 0.001))
	model.animate(delta, direction.length() * speed)

func restore(snapshot: Dictionary) -> void:
	position = Vector3(snapshot.position[0], snapshot.position[1], snapshot.position[2])
	rotation.y = snapshot.get("yaw", 0.0)
	pitch = 0
	velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	health = snapshot.health
	magazines.assign(snapshot.magazines)
	reserves.assign(snapshot.reserves)
	reload_timer = 0
	shot_timer = 0
	damage_flash = 0
	fire_requested = false
	aiming = false
	crouching = false
	recoil = 0
	view_kick = 0.0
	flash_time = 0.0
	mouse_impulse = Vector2.ZERO
	mouse_sway = Vector2.ZERO
	aim_blend = 0.0
	movement_blend = 0.0
	sprint_blend = 0.0
	camera.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	camera.fov = 78.0
	camera.position.y = 1.57
	(collider.shape as CapsuleShape3D).height = 1.72
	collider.position.y = 0.86
	switch_weapon(int(snapshot.weapon))
	visual_fire_age = 2.0
	switch_age = 1.0
	model.position = Vector3(0.18, -0.16, -0.56) if weapon_index == 0 else Vector3(0.16, -0.14, -0.52)
	model.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	for i in weapon_rigs.size():
		var rig: Dictionary = weapon_rigs[i]
		var rest: Dictionary = hand_rest[i]
		rig.left.position = rest.left_position
		rig.left.rotation = rest.left_rotation
		rig.right.position = rest.right_position
		rig.right.rotation = rest.right_rotation
		rig.bolt.position = Vector3.ZERO
		rig.bolt.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
		rig.clip.visible = false
		rig.left.pose("grip",1.0,1.0)
		rig.right.pose("grip",1.0,1.0)
		rig.left.update_sleeve()
		rig.right.update_sleeve()
	muzzle_flash.visible = false
	muzzle_light.light_energy = 0.0
	reset_physics_interpolation()

func show_menu(kind: String) -> void:
	menu_kind = kind
	menu.visible = kind not in ["playing", "dialogue"]
	for child in actions.get_children():
		child.free()
	for child in settings_panel.get_children():
		child.free()
	if kind in ["playing", "dialogue"]:
		return
	match kind:
		"briefing":
			menu_title.text = "烽火回声 · 林海归途"
			menu_caption.text = "1938 · 深秋 · 东北抗联\n青岚林场，一份名册，一个等着回山的人。\n你能守住的，只是身边这几步路。"
			_button("开始任务", main.start_new)
			if main.has_save():
				_button("继续检查点", main.continue_checkpoint)
			_button("设置", _show_settings)
			_button("退出", func(): main.get_tree().quit())
		"paused":
			menu_title.text = "任务暂停"
			menu_caption.text = "青岚林场 · 林海归途"
			_button("继续", main.resume)
			_button("返回检查点", main.continue_checkpoint)
			_button("重新开始", main.start_new)
			_button("设置", _show_settings)
			_button("退出", func(): main.get_tree().quit())
		"lost":
			menu_title.text = "任务失败"
			menu_caption.text = "交通线还在等待。"
			_button("返回检查点", main.continue_checkpoint)
			_button("重新开始", main.start_new)
			_button("退出", func(): main.get_tree().quit())
		"won":
			menu_title.text = "一起回山"
			menu_caption.text = "陆山和名册都已安全抵达接应点。\n%s\n%s\n用时 %s" % ["你替陆山包扎了伤口，他能自己走完回山的路。" if main.story.people.lu.treated else "陆山带着腿伤走到了渡口，接应的人扶住了他。", "林师傅送出的补给也留在了这次行动的记录里。" if main.story.supply_choice != "none" else "山下的林工仍在等待交通线恢复。", main.elapsed_text()]
			_button("再试一次", main.start_new)
			_button("退出", func(): main.get_tree().quit())
		"journal":
			menu_title.text = "行动记录"
			menu_caption.text = main.story.journal_text()
			_button("返回行动  [J / Esc]", main.resume)
	var first := actions.get_child(0) as Button
	first.grab_focus()
